covers.brief: The red-scarf stick figure lies terrified on a wooden operating table with wide eyes, while a tall Victorian surgeon holds a bone saw and a giant pocket watch under dramatic lighting.
A Victorian surgeon in a dark woolen frock coat raises a gleaming surgical bone saw triumphantly next to a giant brass pocket watch, intense golden spotlight and dark shadows.
The red-scarf stick figure clutches its head in sheer disbelief and shock beside an antique wooden hospital bed, bold dramatic contrast under bright stage lighting.
